## About
We're L & P Plumbing, based on Canion St in Austin. We work on homes and businesses across the greater Austin area, from a simple faucet replacement to full rough-in plumbing for new construction.
When you call, you'll likely meet Alex, Ben, Zach or Braylen. One customer wrote about Alex fighting traffic to reach a main line leak and getting it fixed that evening. Another said Ben handled their job with an honesty you don't find often these days.
We put your needs first and stand behind our work. Fair pricing with no hidden fees, clear communication, and we leave your space cleaner than we found it. Rated 4.8 from 181 Google reviews.

## Services
- Underslab Plumbing: Inspections, repairs and slab leak detection for the piping beneath your concrete slab foundation.
- Water Heater Replacement: Replacing an outdated unit or upgrading to tankless, installed for safe, efficient operation.
- Water Pipeline Repair: From a small pipe leak to a full line replacement, for homes and businesses.
- Drain Cleaning: Clearing slow and clogged drains with professional-grade equipment, from the kitchen sink to the main sewer line.
- Sewer Line Repair: Cracked pipes, tree roots and repeat backups, assessed and fixed to restore proper flow.
- Leak Detection & Repairs: Finding hidden leaks behind walls, under floors or beneath the foundation, then repairing them.
- Emergency Plumbing Services: Burst pipes, sewer backups and overflowing fixtures that can't wait for business hours.

## FAQ
Q: What should I do during a plumbing emergency?
A: Shut off your main water supply right away to prevent damage, then call our emergency plumbing team.

Q: When should I replace my water heater?
A: Consider it if your unit is over 10 years old, is running inefficiently, gives you inconsistent hot water or keeps needing repairs.

Q: How can I tell if I have a leak?
A: Watch for unexpectedly high water bills, musty odors, water stains or visible mold.

Q: What fixtures can you install?
A: Sinks, toilets, faucets, showers, bathtubs and the other major plumbing fixtures in your home.

Q: What areas do you serve?
A: Austin and the surrounding communities: Buda, Cedar Park, Georgetown, Hutto, Kyle, Lakeway, Liberty Hill, Pflugerville, Round Rock, San Marcos and Westlake.
